title: 1975-11-05_SECTION_013_11.txt
concise_summary: PKD argues that his 2-3-74 experience was a divinely-appointed reward for his anti-war political resistance, and that it coincided with a secret millennial takeover of worldly government by Christ following Nixon's fall. He deploys the Book of Revelation's beast-sequence to map Nixon as the 666-beast and speculatively identifies Carter as a potential Antichrist, while using his visionary contact with what he believes was a resurrected early Christian saint — intensely preoccupied with Rome — as evidence that the Parousia has occurred. In a pivotal self-correction at the entry's close, PKD revises his theological framework: what he had interpreted as possession by an early saint is re-theorized as contact with the Neoplatonic Summum Bonum, the 'form of forms,' making his 3-74 attainment philosophical rather than properly theological, and Christianity itself a category of Platonic a priori knowledge.
key_claims: PKD's 2-3-74 mystical experience was a divine reward granted in efficient-cause terms (recompense for his anti-war suffering) and final-cause terms (equipping him for future work).

There has been a secret millennial takeover of government by Christ as rightful king, operating invisibly just as Satan's prior rule was invisible, with Nixon's fall as a concrete sign of the end-times.

The entity that possessed PKD during theolepsy was not an individual early Christian saint but the Neoplatonic Summum Bonum — the 'form of forms' — which encised on him from outside time, making his attainment philosophical, not theological in the strict sense.
Primary Christianity is now to be understood as the ultimate category of Platonic a priori knowledge, with Christ as a Platonic-archetypal-form exemplar.

The resurrected saint's intense preoccupation with Rome as the singular enemy of Christianity confirms PKD's visionary identification of the modern US and Soviet Union as the 'twin prongs of Rome,' and corroborates his theolepsy as authentically early Christian.

The dead sleep until Judgment Day with no interim existence (agreeing with Jehovah's Witnesses), as evidenced by the resurrected saint arriving directly from ancient Rome with no gap in experiential continuity.
recurring_concepts: Summum Bonum (S.B.) — Neoplatonic form of forms, the ultimate good, source of the 3-74 experience
Theolepsy — divine possession or takeover of PKD's ego by an external spiritual entity
The Parousia — the secret second coming of Christ, understood as already occurring
Palm tree universe / Secret Garden — PKD's visionary millennial realm, equated with the Kingdom of Christ
Rome as eternal empire — the trans-historical enemy of Christianity, continuous from ancient Rome through modern US and Soviet Union
VALIS / teaching satellite system — referenced obliquely as the perpetual 'printing out' of the Summum Bonum form onto Western Civilization
The Beast / 666 / Antichrist — the Revelation sequence applied to Nixon (first beast) and potentially Carter (second beast/Antichrist)
Phosphene activity — the visible manifestation of the Summum Bonum encising on PKD
people_entities: Nixon, Richard — US president, identified as the 666 beast of Revelation, whose fall PKD reads as the overthrow of the Prince of This World
Carter, Jimmy ('Jimmie Carter') — incoming US president, speculatively identified as either God's mouthpiece or the Antichrist
St. Luke — early Christian saint PKD believes he may have witnessed returning in a living person
Parmenides — pre-Socratic philosopher; PKD invokes 'Form One of Parmenides' to describe the millennial vision
Plato — philosopher whose theory of forms and the Summum Bonum PKD uses to reframe his entire 3-74 experience
Calvin, John — Protestant theologian; PKD references his 'stripped-away theory' regarding restored faculties needed to perceive the Parousia
Doris — unidentified acquaintance who poses the rhetorical question about missing the Parousia when it arrives
Tessa — PKD's wife, who could not see the white light signifying the Angel of Death on the night Pinky died
Paul — a friend of PKD's whose early visionary dream prophesied PKD's troubles as 'a Marin County writer'
Dr. Abernathy — character in Deus Irae who has a vision of the holy palm land (fictional)
Lufteufel — character in a novel (Deus Irae) who 'dies' analogously to Nixon (fictional)
Pinky — PKD's cat, understood as a vessel through whom Christ passed through the stations of the cross and returned to Heaven
texts_works: Book of Revelation (New Testament) — beast sequence, dragon, 666, Antichrist, used as apocalyptic framework
Book of Daniel (Old Testament) — cited alongside Revelation as apocalyptic literature with symbolic beasts
The Jerusalem Bible — PKD cites its introduction to Revelation identifying Rome as the sole real enemy of Christianity and the Antichrist
Deus Irae (PKD novel, co-authored with Roger Zelazny) — Dr. Abernathy's vision of the palm land / holy land cited as parallel to PKD's own vision
Flow My Tears, the Policeman Said ('TEARS') — PKD's novel, his last anti-regime act before 3-74; cited as containing early Christian religious material unrecognized even by its author
autobiographical: PKD describes the period before 2-3-74 as the 'Time of Great Tribulation,' referencing documented suffering during his anti-war political resistance
PKD states he fired off TEARS (Flow My Tears) as his last act against the regime before the 3-74 experience and reward
PKD notes that in 28 months he has created an enormous exegesis of his 3-74 experience
PKD describes November 17, 1971, as a night when he 'lost everything I owned' as a consequence of his resistance (referenced in the evidence_excerpts)

PKD describes witnessing a white light on a night when Tessa could not see it, signifying the Angel of Death come for his cat Pinky, whose death a few days later validated his supernatural perception-system
PKD states he has now 'lost those perceptions and returned to the deformed norm,' no longer able to see the white light
PKD recounts that during theolepsy the possessing entity viewed Rome with intense fear, aversion, and suspicion — a clue PKD says he had not previously fully grappled with
PKD states he remained from March through August [1974] in an altered state, through his surgery and mending
theological_motifs: Millennial Kingdom — the secret millennial age already inaugurated by Christ's invisible overthrow of the beast
Parousia — the second coming understood as already occurring, invisibly, recognized only by a faithful elect
Theolepsy / divine possession — the taking over of PKD's ego by an external divine or spiritual entity
Soul sleep — the dead are unconscious until Judgment Day, per Jehovah's Witnesses, confirmed by the resurrected saint's direct temporal leap from ancient Rome
Apokatastasis / Restoration of all things — the restoration PKD says began after the 3-74 intervention
Prince of This World — Satanic ruler cast down at the time of the 3-74 events
Antichrist — the second beast of Revelation, potentially identified with Carter as worse than Nixon
Stations of the Cross — PKD interprets Pinky's death as Christ passing through the stations of the cross
Cosmic Christ / Rightful King — Christ as invisible sovereign who has already taken over governance of the world
Summum Bonum — Neoplatonic ultimate good reinterpreted as the source of PKD's 3-74 experience, encising from outside time
Philosopher-King — PKD retroactively identifies his political activism as acting in the Platonic role of philosopher-king
Calvin's doctrine of stripped-away faculties — the idea that only those with supernaturally restored faculties can perceive the Parousia
literary_self_ref: TEARS (Flow My Tears, the Policeman Said) is described as PKD's last anti-regime act; he notes it contains religious material that even its author did not recognize until his eyes were opened — a self-deprecating comment about his own blindness to his fiction's theological content

DEUS IRAE: Dr. Abernathy's vision of the holy palm land is cited as a fictional parallel to PKD's own visionary experience of the millennial palm tree universe, suggesting his fiction prophetically encoded his later visions

The government in TEARS is noted to resemble not only the Soviet government but also Rome, and PKD connects this to his theoleptic experience of Rome as the eternal enemy — suggesting his fiction was channeling early Christian spiritual perception

PKD asks rhetorically 'Who sees the religious material in TEARS?' suggesting the novel's theological content is visible only to those with restored spiritual faculties, paralleling the invisibility of the Parousia to secular observers
symbols_images: Palm tree universe — the visionary millennial realm PKD calls the 'Secret Garden,' equated with the Kingdom of Christ or God
White light — supernatural light visible to PKD but not to Tessa, signifying the Angel of Death's presence at Pinky's death
Phosphene activity — the visual manifestation of the Summum Bonum form encising on PKD during 3-74
Prison built in advance — PKD's metaphor: 'we have been freed from a prison before it was built,' describing preemptive divine liberation from a tyranny that never fully materialized
The trumpet's loud clamor — PKD's phrase for the divine intervention that will respond if a worse tyrant than Nixon emerges
Christ suit — PKD's sardonic image for the Antichrist: 'the smile masks death,' wearing the external form of virtue without the content
Ten horns — the literal beasts of Revelation that fundamentalists expect; PKD strips this symbolism to reveal its modern political analog
Wheels still turning — PKD's image for the resurrected early Christian saint who arrived from ancient Rome still in motion, ready for battle
Feet moving before touching ground — the saint 'thrown right into the battle' at Armageddon
tensions: PKD's central self-correction: he declares that what he thought was possession by an early Christian saint resurrected from 2,000 years ago was actually contact with the atemporal Neoplatonic Summum Bonum — these two explanatory frameworks are mutually exclusive and the revision is abrupt and partial, not fully reconciled in this entry

PKD simultaneously maintains the contents of his 3-74 experience are correct (the millennial kingdom is real, Christ reigns) while revising his account of how he acquired that knowledge — this raises the question of whether the corrected mechanism undermines the conclusions drawn from it

PKD hedges his identification of Carter as Antichrist ('I personally am pessimistic') while also admitting it is 'obscured now, but time will tell' — he cannot commit to either the optimistic or apocalyptic reading

PKD invokes the Jehovah's Witnesses approvingly for their soul-sleep doctrine and millennial analysis, while simultaneously positioning his own experiential knowledge as superior to their faith-based and historical analysis — a tension between institutional and personal gnosis

PKD claims the possessing entity was an early Christian saint, then claims it was the atemporal Summum Bonum, yet continues to describe the entity in personal terms ('he just kept on truckin'') — the personalist language persists after the depersonalizing Neoplatonic revision

PKD states 'God is not involved in this, nor Christ qua Christ' in the Neoplatonic reframing, which directly contradicts the theistic framework dominating the earlier portions of the same entry where God intervenes, rewards, and the rightful king Christ rules
evidence_quotes: I say, then, that there has been a secret take-over of gov­ernment by the rightful king, Christ. Probably He will reveal him­self by slow stages (most secret coups work this way anyhow).
The ultimate hoax, which is the anti-Christ wearing a Christ suit; the smile masks death.
If I said to any learned person, 'An early Christian saint fearing and detesting Rome has come to life in my head — what does it mean?' he'd reply, 'Good Lord! The Parousia is here!'
My attainment was philosophical, not theo­logical, to be technically accurate; primary Christianity is now a category —in fact the ultimate category— of a priori knowledge in Plato's sense.
Like me personally, we have been freed from a prison before it was built; God interceded in advance.
uncertainty_flags: The 'friend Paul' whose early visionary dream predicted PKD's troubles as 'a Marin County writer' is not identified — it is unclear whether this is the apostle Paul encountered in visions, a living friend named Paul, or a fictional reference

PKD's identification of 'Lufteufel' as a character who 'dies' like Nixon in a novel is ambiguous — Lufteufel does not appear prominently in the known PKD bibliography and may be a character from Deus Irae or a confused reference

The date '94' appears in the text ('show in what ways the situation here in 94 would differ') — this appears to be a manuscript/transcription error or an obscure reference (possibly page 94 of the exegesis manuscript, not the year 1994)

PKD's Neoplatonic reframing at the entry's end ('PAY-OFF TIME!') is presented as a sudden insight that revises his entire prior framework, but the entry ends mid-sentence ('God is not involved in this, nor Christ qua Christ, but all were') — the conclusion is truncated

The identity of 'Doris' is not established — she may be a friend, a fictional character, or Doris Sauter (a PKD acquaintance), and her rhetorical question about the Parousia is cited approvingly without context

PKD conflates 'the second beast' with 'the Antichrist' in Revelation, then admits confusion ('It's very confusing... Beats me') — his exegesis of the Revelation beast-sequence is acknowledged as uncertain even by himself

PKD states Moscow has been called 'the third Rome' — a historically real concept (Moscow as Third Rome) but PKD uses it to support his theoleptic Rome-identification without distinguishing the historical claim from his visionary interpretation
reading_excerpt: My attainment was philosophical, not theo­logical, to be technically accurate; primary Christianity is now a category —in fact the ultimate category— of a priori knowledge in Plato's sense.
raw_text: book by my friend Paul in an early visionary dream: "A Marin County writer will have troubles..." etc), you can better see how I came to be picked in 3-74 for a reward; I hope this isn't hubris, but I did pay heavily for my anti-war stand, and that is a fact. That was the well-documented Time of Great Tribulation — cut short in 3-74 by God, to spare me. And then the restoration of all things began. My last act against the regime was when I fired off TEARS and it was published. So from the standpoint of efficient causes the experience can be understood (a reward following what I did and what was done to me), and also in final-cause terms, it gave me wisdom and strength to do what I still had to do; such is the dovetailing of a true cosmos. In 28 months I've created an enormous exegesis of my 3-74 experience, which is what you are supposed to do: subject the mystical to the rational and see what comes of it. Look where I wind up. Now what can we expect? A return of the early saints, such as St. Luke — I believe this, too, has happened, and that I witnessed it in regard to one of them anyhow. The tribulations occured; the intervention and judging occured; the throwing down of the Prince of This World occured; now the millenial age is with us, but just as secretly as was the rule by Satan (as the JWs point out). I saw that millenial age in the palm tree universe. The Secret Garden, as I have called it: The Kingdom of Christ or God. But to appreciate this age completely we would have to have experienced where we'd be now if God hadn't intervened: probably completely downtrodden by the tyranny, our freedoms gone, and probably at war. It is the contrast which reveals, and we will never experience the contrast. Like me personally, we have been freed from a prison before it was built; God interceded in advance. So we can only guess what the alternative world would have been like. I personally would not be here at all. In DEUS IRAE the vision of the palm land,'the Holy Land, by Dr. Abernathy, signifies that the curse has been lifted; I deduce that my seeing it indicated too for us or for me, too. This is how the world ought to be; or, put another way, this is how we ought to see/experience it (Form One of Parmenides). The tyrant Nixon "died," like Lufteufel in the novel...and the curse was lifted; it is another absolute sign of the end-times. -11- I say, then, that there has been a secret take-over of gov¬ ernment by the rightful king, Christ. Probably He will reveal him¬ self by slow stages (most secret coups work this way anyhow). Now I ask, How does Jimmie Carter, our next president I guess, fit into this? I think, He is either very good or very bad, an absolute in one of those two columns for sure. Either he is God's mouthpiece or he is an even worse tyrant. It is obscured now, but time will tell. If he is a greater tyrant, perhaps the ultimate one, God will rise readily to the challenge. God did not depose Nixon to allow an even worse person in; that seems self-evident. "The trumpet's loud clamor" will be heard again, if necessary. I personally am pessimistic. We are going to get the form of virtue, the externals, without the content, I think; I intuit this. The ultimate hoax, which is the anti-Christ wearing a Christ suit; the smile masks death. In Revelation, there is first the 666 beast (which I have identified as Nixon) and after he is thrown down, the Anti-Christ appears who is worse yet, who is Satan himself; but Christ throws him down, too. Hmmm. Nixon, then Carter. (I've been looking through Revelation and I see there are two beasts, but evidently the second beast is the Antichrist. It's very confusing. Also there's a dragon, before the 2 beasts. Beats me.) One very interesting thing said in the Jerusolam Bible: That Rome and its empire is the sole real enemy of Christianity, and is the Antichrist (I recall how Rome figured in my visions, the memory of the spirit of evil Rome, his enemy; also I think, too, that the modern day US is an extension into time of Rome, which never fell but underwent external face-lifts. Anyhow this remark & analysis in the J. Bible corroberates my visionary experiences vis-a-vis Rome; also I've remarked that the government in TEARS is not only like the Soviet government but like Rome, and Moscow has been called the third Rome.) (The J. Bible's remarks about Rome in intro to Revelation nails down my visionary tneoleptic experiences for sure as early Christian; beyond doubt.) (If an authentic early Christian saint were to be resurrection within one, he would feel and convey such sentiments —and preoccupation— re Rome.- (And who else would, pray tell?) (Wow, for my tutelary spirit it was the burning issue, the adversary. Thus my contention about what took me over is strengthened. (I have not ever really grappled with this aspect of my theolepsy, the intense fear & aversion and suspicion it felt regarding Rome; now I think it was a clue of enormous magnitude, offering me a further opportunity to pin down absolutely who and what had usurped my ego. It conceived every secular antagonist as an expression of Rome. "Rome" was the critical opera¬ tional word; it literally saw Rome when it looked around itself here in this world, after it first arrived. "The one authentic enemy which could destroy Christianity"; well, that was his/its view, all right. Jeez; if it was an early Christian resurrected to second life in me, then the Parousia for sure had come! If I said to any learned person, "An early Christian saint fearing and detesting Rome has come to life in my head — what does it mean?" he'd reply, "Good Lord! The Parousia is here!" -12- Also, he was raring to go; he just kept on truckin', as if his wheels were still turning from the spin out on them in his own time. He certainly hadn't been anywhere in the meanwhile! (I.e. he came directly from Rome right to here.) That shows you where we go when we die: again the JW are correct, we're asleep until awakened on —yeep— judgment day, as evidently he was, and again we're back to the Parousia; he certainly hadn't lived an interem existence, in Heaven or anywhere else. And — he correctly apprise the situation, here, as the final battle: the situation and the enemy (the twin prongs of Rome, US and Soviet). Bewildered as he was he knew what was expected of him; the situation which greeted him was exactly the one he had prepared for & anticipated. No, there was no short km circuit; nothing which he expected had gone wrong or failed to materialize. It all took place according to their original plan. His feet were moving before he touched group. He was thrown right into the battle. Well, people such as him were/are the first-line troops at Armeggedon. The commanders or officers, as it were. They would be the ones who would understand the situation; I certainly didn't until I assimilated it from his mind. (Test: show in what ways the situation here in 94 would differ from what he expected. Answer: in no ways.) Like Doris says, "How could anyone miss seeing the Parousia when it comes?" but the first main event is the overthrow of the beast (the Antichrist), and if people don't/didn't see the beast qua beast anyhow, but voted it into office with the biggest mandate in history, they might see it overthrown without attaching any religious or supernatural significance to its passing, especially if the foe of the beast, the champion of man, Christ, were invisible; they would see the effects but not the source or cause. This is a secular age. The atheists would deny it, and the fundamentalists who are the main body who're waiting think in concrete terms regard¬ ing apocalyptic literature and would expect true physical beasts with ten horns, etc., nothing being symbolic to them. If you strip away the lurid symbolism of Revelation and Daniel you get this: the modern analog or descendent or form of Rome, the despotic empire and tyranny, will be overthrown by the Cosmic Christ during a time of great tribula¬ tion generally, in terms of war and famine, etc. After that, things will get better, since the rightful King now rules. a tyrant and an empire get overthrown by mostly invisible heavenly powers, but how much overt epiphany would there be? Maybe the Cosmic Christ would manifest himself only to a faithful elect (ahem). Put another way, Only to those actually involved. (As few as necessary? Who sees the religious material in TEARS? to give a small example; even the author who had the dream didn't, not until his eyes were opened for him (we get back to the stripped-away theory of Calvin). They will see it only if their faculties are restored, maybe; and that may be a long, slow process lasting generations. The main thing is the event, whether or not seen, which means the end of the oppression (of true Christians especially), and that has indeed happened. I don't see any incarnations (into flesh) in the cards, then or now. After all, Tessa couldn't see the white light that signified the presence of the Angel of Death that night when it came to claim Pinky; his death a -13- few days later demonstrated the reliability of my supernatural percep-system and by extension validated my other perceptions, but I doubt if I would see it now, I having lost those perceptions and returning to the deformed norm. But then, too, it wasn't Pinky but the Savior himself in there, as He was in me too. Pinky or Christ passed through the stations of the cross (we mocked him, etc), and returned once more to his origin: Heaven. It was all very real. Pinky returned because He returned; He led Pinky back home, and stayed with us from March through August, until after my surgery & mending. Thus I saw (correctly) in Pinky what was also in me. PAY-OFF TIME! Last night I had a mystical insight about my 3-74 mystical insight; viz: As to the contents of my 3-74 experience I am right (supra), but as to how I acquired the knowledge & experience, wrong. What took place actually stamps my experience as Neoplatonistic, inasmuch as what encised on me was the form of forms, the Summum Bonuum, whose contents were (1) the form and balance of Apollonian philosophy, and (2) primary Christianity, as a further development along the lines of Christ as Platonic-archetypal-form exemplar. In a nutshell, that is it. There was no one from 2,000 years ago who came here; the S.B. exemplar form in itself (which is what I saw as phosphene activity) incised from outside of time, and is always encising to some degree on every person within Western Civilization; it is perpetually printing out, very much like my "teaching satelliteVALISYSTEM A idea". My attainment was philosophical, not theo¬ logical, to be technically accurate; primary Christianity is now a category —in fact the ultimate category— of a priori knowledge in Plato's sense. Every "theolepsic" change in me was due to the S.B. exemplar archetypal form of forms encising balance and proportion, ratio, harmony, on me; I became, for reasons I don't know, the receptible of being, which is to say passive matter. I achieved the goal of the Platonists...also, my politcal activism at that time was the actions of a "philosopher king," in Plato's sense. God is not involved in this, nor Christ qua Christ, but all were
